context_search.title: context_search
context_search.description: Return a bounded, scope-authorized, labeled candidate set - the active project's memories plus applicable global engineering records, retained solution cases, code and evidence - found by exact handle, lexical BM25 match, or bounded typed traversal, without asserting that any candidate is true.

schema_version.description: Matched on MAJOR. Any minor is accepted; minor additions are additive-only.

request_id.description: UUIDv7, lowercase hex, exactly 36 characters. Caller-generated, unique per attempt, echoed on every response and every receipt. Not an idempotency key: a retry keeps the idempotency key and issues a new request_id. Lowercase is deliberate, so two spellings of one id cannot both be accepted.

deadline_ms.description: A relative budget, not an absolute timestamp: host and container clocks are not assumed synchronized. The core computes and echoes deadline_at.

project_key.description: Required when store is project or both. A missing or ambiguous binding returns kioku.project_binding_unresolved and never falls back to global.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized request body excluding request_id, deadline_ms and correlation. The core recomputes it; the asserted value is checked, never trusted.

expected_revision.description: Null or absent means create. A stale value returns kioku.revision_conflict carrying the current revision.

correlation.description: Correlation hints only. The core records identity_source and leaves attribution_state unresolved when the join cannot be established; it never infers identity from timing or process id. Closed on purpose: this is the nesting an identity field would otherwise be smuggled in through.

envelope.description: Reads carry no idempotency fields. Supplying one is refused with kioku.invalid_request: an idempotency receipt is a durability claim, a read produces none, and accepting the field would invite a caller to believe a read had been deduplicated.
envelope.title: read envelope

mode.description: exact, lexical and related are the three retrieval mechanisms. 'solutions' is the deprecated alias of the research's mode='solutions' and maps server-side to {mode:lexical, profile:solutions}. semantic and hybrid are permanently absent: embeddings are out of scope, and supplying either returns kioku.unsupported_operation.

query.description: Required when mode=lexical. The bounded user or agent query text.

keys.description: Required when mode=exact. Typed handles or exact locators. Short identifiers resolve here and must not depend on substring matching.

edge_kinds.description: Required when mode=related. An unvalidated name returns kioku.unsupported_operation, not kioku.invalid_request.

authority.x-kioku-core-derived-exempt: A predicate over the authority label already recorded on stored rows. It narrows what is returned and asserts nothing about the caller.

expand.description: Bounded neighbour expansion for mode=exact or lexical. hops above 2 returns kioku.unsupported_operation.

highlight.description: Snippet previews. Automatically disabled with warning highlight_unsupported for fuzzy queries; a snippet is a preview, never an exact evidence handle.

include_disputed.description: When false, factual assertions with an open dispute are suppressed from confident delivery but governing user decisions, constraints and corrections are still returned with the objection attached.

require_source_validation.description: When true, an unvalidatable dependency returns kioku.source_unavailable instead of an applicability=unknown label.

solutions.note: The research writes context_search(mode='solutions'); this contract makes mode the retrieval mechanism and profile the subject route. The alias expands server-side and the response reports actual_mode='lexical'.

context_fetch.title: context_fetch
context_fetch.description: Return the exact bytes, ranges or revisions behind already-identified handles in bounded batches, re-authorizing scope and re-checking deletion state on every request. An object id, content hash or handle grants no access by itself.

ranges.description: Per-handle sub-ranges keyed by handle key. An out-of-range request is truncated and reported in coverage, never silently clamped.

include_provenance.description: Derivation chain, shared roots and lineage_state. Shared evidence lineage is not independent confirmation.

revalidate_source.description: Applies to source_range handles: a batch host check of the selected dependencies under the caller's deadline. A disconnected control connection yields historical or unknown, never source_checked.

as_of_revision.description: Pin a historical revision. Historical content is always labelled applicability=historical and can never acquire a current-source label.

x-kioku-refusals.per_item_in_a_batch: data.unavailable[] with a named reason, and the request status becomes partial

context_related.title: context_related
context_related.description: Answer a typed relationship question - callers, decision rationale, change impact, evidence lineage - by bounded traversal from authorized seeds, returning explicit depth, fanout and coverage limits instead of an exhaustive graph.

direction.description: Forward and reverse indexes are maintained separately.

include_unresolved_targets.description: Unresolved external targets stay explicitly qualified rather than being dropped.

diversity.description: So high-degree utility symbols do not dominate the result set.

x-kioku-labelling.note: A traversal-expanded result set is a bounded candidate pool, not the declared match set, and is labelled as such. The label survives the removal of vector candidate pools.

context_remember.title: context_remember
context_remember.description: Commit one evidence-linked durable memory revision to an explicitly named project or global destination, returning saved only after canonical commit and queued only after durable host enqueue. A save records a conclusion; it never establishes support, so claim_support and authority are core-derived and have no input property here.

ref.description: Exactly one of evidence_key, object_key or event_key. A well-formed ref this build cannot resolve is NOT a malformed request: it is reported per entry in data.evidence_rejected with a named reason, and only an empty eligible set fails the call with kioku.evidence_required.

evidence.description: At least one link. The core validates scope, source-anchor schema and object availability before commit. A well-formed ref it cannot resolve is reported in data.evidence_rejected; only an empty eligible set fails with kioku.evidence_required.

applicability.description: Required when store_kind=global. A global record without applicability conditions is refused: a reusable statement with no declared limits is not reusable.

memory_key.description: Append a revision to an existing memory. Pairs with envelope.expected_revision: without it the write is a create, and the published envelope's expected_revision has nothing to apply to.

lifecycle.description: Assistant-authored global records default to proposed and do not become governing user preferences by repetition.

mandatory.description: User authority only. An assistant actor setting it returns kioku.authority_violation. This is an input, not a core-derived field: the caller asks, the core decides whether the asking actor may.

context_feedback.title: context_feedback
context_feedback.description: Attach an attributed dispute or usefulness/irrelevance signal to one exact memory revision, project or global, preserving the objection and its disposition without mutating or cancelling the target.

target.description: An exact revision, not a head pointer. A head-only reference returns kioku.invalid_request, because a dispute must name what was actually disputed.

ref.description: Exactly one of evidence_key, object_key or event_key. A well-formed ref this build cannot resolve is NOT a malformed request: it is reported per entry in data.evidence_rejected with a named reason, and only an empty eligible set fails the call with kioku.evidence_required.

evidence.description: Evidence for the objection. Optional here: an objection may be a judgment, and the contract requires an eligible link only on context_remember.

disposition.description: Only the authorized party may set resolved or withdrawn; resolving another principal's dispute returns kioku.authority_violation. Resolving a dispute does not by itself verify its source.

feedback_key.description: Update an existing feedback record's disposition. Pairs with envelope.expected_revision and carries its own idempotency receipt.

proposed_override.description: A routing hint only. context_feedback never writes a project override: the response returns a prepared override request that the caller submits through context_remember's override variant. Override authority stays on the write path.

context_task.description: Maintain one project-bound task's contract, material claims, immutable candidates, planned checks, checkpoints, assessments and scoped completion through a discriminated eight-operation schema that is not an arbitrary command or SQL interface. A task always resolves to exactly one project.

authority.x-kioku-core-derived-exempt: Per-criterion provenance on a task contract, required as a declared input by task_operations.set_contract. Recording which authority a criterion claims is what lets the core refuse an assistant actor relaxing a user-authority criterion. The claim does not grant the authority.

schema_version.description: Matched on MAJOR. Any minor is accepted; minor additions are additive-only.

request_id.description: UUIDv7, lowercase hex, exactly 36 characters. Caller-generated, unique per attempt, echoed on every response and every receipt. Not an idempotency key: a retry keeps the idempotency key and issues a new request_id. Lowercase is deliberate, so two spellings of one id cannot both be accepted.

deadline_ms.description: A relative budget, not an absolute timestamp: host and container clocks are not assumed synchronized. The core computes and echoes deadline_at.

project_key.description: Required when store is project or both. A missing or ambiguous binding returns kioku.project_binding_unresolved and never falls back to global.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized request body excluding request_id, deadline_ms and correlation. The core recomputes it; the asserted value is checked, never trusted.

expected_revision.description: Null or absent means create. A stale value returns kioku.revision_conflict carrying the current revision.

correlation.description: Correlation hints only. The core records identity_source and leaves attribution_state unresolved when the join cannot be established; it never infers identity from timing or process id. Closed on purpose: this is the nesting an identity field would otherwise be smuggled in through.

envelope.description: Reads carry no idempotency fields. Supplying one is refused with kioku.invalid_request: an idempotency receipt is a durability claim, a read produces none, and accepting the field would invite a caller to believe a read had been deduplicated.
envelope.title: read envelope

at_contract_revision.description: A historical view, always labelled applicability=historical.

op_get.description: Read-only projection. Returns state, heads and the generation vector so a later close can pass matching expected_heads.
